title: world_created/1 — POST /worlds 201: the directory entry that now exists (SPEC-028)
description: Mirrors one world_directory/1 entry, so a client parses the thing it just created with the same reader it uses for the list. playable is always false here: creation writes a directory row and the world's operating defaults, and authors NO entities — no player, no rooms, nothing to perceive. A freshly created world is real, listed, and not yet enterable, which is the honest state rather than a template's invented fiction.
